comment: Kingbot UI registry - one entry per button/element. Lookup order: template picture -> OCR text -> relative to another element -> remembered position. Add an element here instead of writing code.

alliance_help_button.note: handshake button (city HUD, above the bottom row); icon found at any scale

queue_button.note: three-line button under the age label; opens Queue Overview

info_button.note: the small (i) hexagon shown when a building is selected

train_button.note: the Train button of a selected military building; no readable text on this client

speedup_button.note: the speedup hexagon shown next to a building that is training

no_button.note: the NO of a spend-gems window; never skipped
